## Decisions

- [the-manual-is-markdown-a-site-you-must-start-is-not-read](the-manual-is-markdown-a-site-you-must-start-is-not-read.md) — decided · 2026-08-31 — the fumadocs site is deleted and the manual becomes plain markdown shipped with the shell, searched line by line through a television channel bound to `?`, because a manual you have to build and serve before you can read it does not get read
- [tests-and-gates-retire-a-dev-setup-is-not-a-product](tests-and-gates-retire-a-dev-setup-is-not-a-product.md) — decided · 2026-08-31 — tests/ and gates/ are deleted and the configs are stripped of their board scaffolding; the knowledge they carried moves into a generated, searchable docs site, because this tree is one person's dev setup and not a shipped product
- [tmux-owns-multiplexing-wezterm-keeps-the-chrome](tmux-owns-multiplexing-wezterm-keeps-the-chrome.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — tmux takes windows, panes, addressing and scrollback so the config survives a restart and follows an ssh; WezTerm keeps only what is local to this machine, and invariants I1 and I2 are reversed to allow it
- [mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap](mason-refresh-off-trades-auto-bootstrap.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — Turning mason's registry refresh off buys back the discarded first save and costs the automatic fresh-machine bootstrap, which install.sh now owes
- [derived-tripwire-continue-both](derived-tripwire-continue-both.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — The live derived-work tripwire is answered with continue-both — corrections run alongside the deliverable
- [complexity-is-node-level-specs-sum-to-it](complexity-is-node-level-specs-sum-to-it.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — A PRD's complexity is the analyst's node-level weight and its specs are scored to sum to roughly that; the protocol's "summed into" is the consistency rule, not a second scale
- [an-unattributed-red-has-no-owner](an-unattributed-red-has-no-owner.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — A red outside every claimed footprint belongs to nobody by default — the orchestrator routes it at collect time, and "not mine" is no longer a complete report
- [port-first-over-derived-findings](port-first-over-derived-findings.md) — decided · 2026-08-23 — The port outranks the board's own findings; corrections take only the worker slots the port cannot use
- [a-prose-footprint-is-invisible-to-the-planner](a-prose-footprint-is-invisible-to-the-planner.md) — decided · 2026-08-23 — A spec's footprint must be frontmatter; a prose Footprint line is documentation the wave planner cannot read
- [a-counterfactual-proves-its-own-mutation](a-counterfactual-proves-its-own-mutation.md) — decided · 2026-08-23 — A gate's green counterfactual must assert red-before-repair and prove its mutation changed the tree; an end-state grep is not proof

## Notes

- [an-invariant-naming-a-defect-must-be-re-measured-before-a-child-inherits-it](an-invariant-naming-a-defect-must-be-re-measured-before-a-child-inherits-it.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — an invariant naming a defect must be re-measured before a child inherits it
- [an-absence-assertion-needs-a-positive-precondition-or-it-is-green-on-a-blank-screen](an-absence-assertion-needs-a-positive-precondition-or-it-is-green-on-a-blank-screen.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — A check of the form "X is not on the screen" passes when there is no screen; five of them in one harness were green for that reason before a positive precondition was added beside each
- [a-hand-kept-list-standing-in-for-a-property-of-the-tree-is-this-board-s-most-common-defect](a-hand-kept-list-standing-in-for-a-property-of-the-tree-is-this-board-s-most-common-defect.md) — decided · 2026-08-29 — Five independent defects in one week share one mechanism — a maintained list standing in for something the tree already knows — and the tell is that adding a file is correct everywhere except in a list nobody thought to open
- [a-concurrent-lane-trips-the-scratch-guard](a-concurrent-lane-trips-the-scratch-guard.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — gates/selftest.sh's "wrote nothing outside its scratch" check cannot tell a misbehaving gate from another lane writing concurrently — a red naming a file you did not touch is the artifact, not a finding
- [a-commit-that-skips-the-board-leaves-gates-unmaintained](a-commit-that-skips-the-board-leaves-gates-unmaintained.md) — decided · 2026-08-28 — 0b77a71 landed code ahead of its PRD and left two separate gates unmaintained — the registry row and the managed surface — because the spec footprint that would have carried both was never written
- [one-board-two-collision-classifications](one-board-two-collision-classifications.md) — open · 2026-08-24 — Two live checks classify init.lua and config.nu differently — one as an append-only registry, one as exclusive content
- [every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget](every-abort-measurement-was-missing-wget.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — Every board measurement of the offline first-save abort was taken on a PATH with no wget, which the machine has — the bug is unmeasured on a faithful PATH, not reproduced and not refuted
- [a-headless-gate-red-may-be-load-not-code](a-headless-gate-red-may-be-load-not-code.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — A headless-Neovim gate can go red purely from machine load — retry before believing it, and never widen the budget to make it green
- [a-chk-message-substitution-resets-the-status-it-reports](a-chk-message-substitution-resets-the-status-it-reports.md) — decided · 2026-08-24 — backlog-closeout's check01/check02 "landed verify still exits 0" cannot fail — $(…) in the chk message resets $? first
- [a-tree-guard-must-not-guard-machinery-state](a-tree-guard-must-not-guard-machinery-state.md) — decided · 2026-08-23 — A gate's untouched-tree guard must treat the live board as indeterminate — the board machinery writes prds/ while gates run
